sources.snippet: To get every candidate in one call instead of reading back from the model, use model.infer (X, y), which returns an InferenceResult (best Candidate, the score-sorted candidates, and the full CandidateLedger).

sources.title: GitHub - psaegert/flash-ansr: Fast Amortized Neural Symbolic Regression ...
sources.snippet: Flash-ANSR is a library for amortized neural symbolic regression: load a pretrained model, call fit (X, y), and recover a symbolic expression for your tabular data, or train your own model. It is built for fast, ready-to-use inference.
